required_invocation: python3 -I -B <absolute helper path> --revision <explicit newly returned R> --destination <absolute external expansion directory>
boundaries: Selected revision and prior manifest are explicit content-addressed inputs; no current-ref lookup, Git call or cache-parent-chain validation.
Checks source/catalog/context object bytes and canonical manifest subset/identity coverage; does not repeat lexical imports, role-binding validation or mathematical verification.
One-to-one mapping is between logical and physical path names; hardlinks between regular files are allowed and their bytes are checked.
Rejects extra empty directories as well as extra/missing regular files, symlinks, specials and byte differences.
File reads and before/after filesystem states detect observed drift; this is not a global atomic read, lock protocol or proof against all concurrent/adversarial filesystem changes.
64 MiB per manifest/object/raw file, 100000 total enumerated entries and depth128 are explicit operational resource bounds.
Uses copied relocation rules bound to exact repository_paths.py bytes; refuses owner schema/adapter drift rather than silently following changed rules.
No live-checkout source freshness is claimed; no dependency cache, docs not in selected manifest, executable behavior, Lean proof or runtime refinement is checked.

O_NONBLOCK addresses ordinary FIFO swaps before leaf-open/fstat. It is not a universal deadline for network filesystems, device-driver behavior or all filesystem operations. Streaming scandir bounds retained Python entry collections; it does not prove an absolute kernel/stdlib memory or timing bound.
r2_changes: Leaf os.open adds O_NONBLOCK, immediately checks opened fstat mode is regular, then checks pre-open/opened identity before reading.
Both initial and final directory-name collections use streaming scandir with an explicit pre-append bound.
Initial directory names reserve the global entry budget before recursive descent; final names are bounded by the exact initial directory entry count.
All original file/manifest/object/source guards, symlink/special rejection, path-set comparison, raw-byte comparison, depth bound and final observed-state guards remain.
